name: FacturaScripts
description: FacturaScripts is an open-source ERP and accounting platform for invoicing, purchasing, inventory, customer management and business reporting.

notes.text: Experimental and not production-ready: real Proxmox installation, update, backup and restore testing is still pending.
The service uses HTTP without TLS. Keep it on a trusted network, complete setup at http://<IP>, and replace any default credentials immediately.
Core files are hardened as read-only to Apache, which may block the built-in updater. Updates and rollback are unverified; take a full container backup first.
Backups must include the MariaDB database and /opt/facturascripts/config.php, Plugins, MyFiles and Dinamic until restore behavior is verified.
